per_candidate.id: s2:Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) 12CO(2–1) Gas Dynamics in NG

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the accretion timescale of low-accretion-rate SMBHs or its dependence on black hole mass and accreted gas mass. They are related to SMBHs but do not address the specific question.
